title: Weekly Releases - August 3, 2026
description: GitHub Copilot desktop app, CLI, and VS Code received updates including shared sessions, side questions (/btw), worktree workflows, multilingual dictation, element-level browser feedback, and improved session management.

title: Queueing Support for Automations
description: Devin now supports queuing for automations, allowing multiple tasks to be processed sequentially. Also includes AI-generated review comments and numerous smaller fixes and improvements.

title: v0.54.0 - Security and Infrastructure Enhancements
description: Integrated Antigravity agent runner with Firestore concurrency controls, enhanced caretaker triage, strengthened HTTPS credential enforcement, and added ReAct/prompt injection loop prevention.

title: Acquisition by Cursor
description: Continue has been acquired by Cursor. The open-source codebase remains freely available, and the mission to amplify developers continues under the new ownership.

community_feedback.quote: Continue was a popular open-source alternative to GitHub Copilot. Its removal eliminates a free/open option for developers.
Cursor is eliminating competition by acquiring a popular free/open-source alternative, rather than competing on product merits.
Why the Cursor acquisition should concern every software developer - expressing concerns about vendor lock-in and reduced competition in AI coding assistant space.

title: v0.86.0 Release - GPT-5 and Enhanced Model Support
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models, Grok-4, and new Gemini models. Enhanced user feedback with /clear confirmation messages and improved /undo output display.

title: Google Workspace Plugins Integration
description: Cursor can now read, write, and act across Google Workspace with new plugins giving coding agents direct access to Gmail, Google Drive, and Calendar for enhanced productivity.

title: Cursor Start - New India Pricing Plan
description: New ₹649 monthly plan for developers in India with local pricing and UPI support, including access to Cursor models (Grok 4.5 and Composer), always-on cloud agents, and iOS remote control.

title: Cursor Router - Intelligent Model Routing
description: Auto mode now powered by Cursor Router, an intelligent model router that analyzes each request and sends it to the right model with Intelligence, Balance, and Cost optimization modes.

title: v3.6.27 - Windows Certificate Store Fixes and Security Enhancements
description: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf) v3.6.27 fixes Windows certificate store loading for HTTPS requests, adds symlink protection for file edits, and improves security for corporate environments.

community_feedback.quote: Windsurf was a coolish brand, one I could get behind, Devin seems like anything but that.
Devin has been the most cringy thing I've seen. The lack of communication is also bothersome.
Saying Goodbye (finally) - I have to admit the Devin change is not as bad as I thought

title: v0.53.0 - LLM-based Triage Orchestrator
description: Implemented LLM-based caretaker triage orchestrator, added evaluation coverage reporting, enhanced workspace trust enforcement, and improved macOS Seatbelt profiles with infinite loop mitigation.
